title: Taming CoT Obfuscation in VLMs: From Mechanistic Evidence to Activation Enforcement
abstract: arXiv:2609.24243v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) improves reasoning in vision-language models (VLMs) but can induce chain-of-thought (CoT) obfuscation: an operational, non-intentional outcome where task reward or accuracy rises while traces become less grounded and monitorable. Prior work largely documents this decay behaviorally, leaving its representation-level correlates and actionable controls unclear. We find that template- and ground-associated activations become less separable during RL; matched interventions support the contribution of selected features to monitorability degradation. Guided by this evidence, we propose Targeted Anti-obfuscation with Mechanistic Enforcement (TAME), which uses Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to combine behavioral feedback with targeted suppression of template-associated activations during RL. translated_title: 驯服视觉语言模型中的思维链混淆：从机制证据到激活约束
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）能够提升视觉语言模型（VLM）的推理能力，但可能诱发思维链（CoT）混淆：这是一种操作性的、非意图性的结果，表现为任务奖励或准确率上升的同时，推理轨迹变得缺乏依据且难以监控。先前的工作大多仅在行为层面记录了这种退化现象，其在表示层面的相关因素以及可操作的干预手段仍不清楚。我们发现，在强化学习过程中，模板相关激活与真实依据相关激活变得越来越难以分离；匹配干预实验验证了所识别特征对监控能力退化的贡献。基于这一证据，我们提出了TAME（带有机制约束的定向反混淆方法），该方法利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）在强化学习过程中将行为反馈与对模板相关激活的定向抑制相结合。其非对称约束仅在模板激活超过强化学习前基线时施加惩罚，在锚定局部化特征的同时保持行为表现。
tldr: 该论文揭示了强化学习会导致视觉语言模型出现“思维链混淆”——即准确率上升但推理过程变得难以监控，并提出TAME方法，利用稀疏自编码器在强化学习中定向抑制模板相关激活，从而保持模型推理过程的可监控性。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that RL induces CoT obfuscation in VLMs—where accuracy rises while reasoning traces become less monitorable—and proposes TAME, which uses Sparse Autoencoders to enforce targeted suppression of template-associated activations during RL, preserving reasoning monitorability.
